content: MT5 hedging vs netting mismatch: EAs are coded assuming one specific position-accounting mode. Netting-mode EAs manage a single net position per symbol; hedging-mode EAs open/manage multiple independent positions per symbol. Running an EA built for the wrong mode causes incorrect trade closure, miscalculated risk, or duplicate positions. A single MT5 account can only run one mode -- must be chosen at account opening or changed via broker request, cannot mix. Strategy Tester behavior can also differ/misbehave on hedging accounts versus netting. Best practice: explicitly verify account mode in code (AccountInfoInteger ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE) before any EA logic runs, never assume.
